about.title: About
about.body: Piano Lab is a web-based sound experiment platform. Play with a variety of input devices, customize sound, and edit scores.

synthesis.title: Sound Synthesis
synthesis.body: Sound is synthesized in real time with the Web Audio API. See my article for the math and the source code for the implementation.

notation.title: Score Notation
notation.body: Scores use the ABC Notation format. Read the official tutorial for the full standard.
